summarize_model_config: summarize the ResNeSt-50 ImageClassifier model configuration dict with backbone, neck, head, and train settings
review_model_config: review the ResNeSt-50 model config for backbone depth, num_classes, and label smoothing loss settings
build_image_classifier: build an ImageClassifier with a ResNeSt-50 backbone, GlobalAveragePooling neck, and LinearClsHead for 1000 classes
refactor_model_config: refactor the ResNeSt-50 model config to change the backbone depth, loss function, or Mixup augmentation alpha
test_model_config: test the ResNeSt-50 ImageClassifier config by instantiating the model dict and verifying backbone and head parameters
